content.comment_body: Hello, I plan to use a [product_name] PLC with article number [article_no]. How many digital input/output modules does one [product_name] PLC CPU support?

For all [product_name] devices: Open [product_name] software, go to Tools > Select Hardware, or use the shortcut CTRL + H. You will see the entire [product_name] family. Select your series to access detailed information, including the number of analog and digital inputs/outputs. The model with [article_no] supports up to 24 digital inputs and 16 digital outputs.

The maximum module count for one [product_name] can be found in the [document], specifically in Chapter 2.1.2. This chapter also covers configurations when networking two or more [product_name] devices. Regards,
Thanks for providing the helpful information.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking accurate details regarding expansion possibilities for their [product_name] PLC, particularly the number of supported digital input/output modules per CPU. Advice given points to using relevant software features and consulting official manuals, suggesting that documentation and integrated configuration tools are essential for obtaining this information.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to quickly and reliably access specific details about supported module limits for their [product_name] PLC CPU, preferably through central tools or official documentation.
